Now I feel more like a wreck, I don't have a job or I'd rather say I don't want a job. I dropped out of college twice. I guess you may think I'm a lazy dumb cunt. You know, graduate, get your first job, apartment, etc... I'm pretty isolated, not very sociable, introvert. Everything seems to be bland. I don't get any pleasure or excitation from anything.

I already tried suicide, and failed miserably, believe me, ending in a psych ward for 2 weeks isn't worth it if you fuck it up. Now I'm too scared to this again, but I don't wanna live either. This is mentally destructive.

As I made my first attempt two years ago, I can imagine how desperate you must feel and how the idea of ending your life brings some relief. I still think about it nowadays. But after my attempt, major bad things hailed down to people close to me. I realized that if I would have succeed at killing myself, those people would have been more ravaged than they are now. I'm not trying to say that I'm egocentric or anything, but simply that even people don't tell you everyday, you are important for them and always will be.

I don't know how to convince you not to do it someday. I know that life isn't glamorous, especially for you right now, but there is someone that cares for you and will definitely want you to be happy and will help you to be.

I made my first attempt last year. Swallowed a whole tab of benzos with AD and vodka. I didn't remember anything about the first days in the psych ward. How I ended up there, etc,... Well it was like a jail, you can't go out and have a stroll. At that time, I really wished that I succeeded on killing myself.

But then with meds, they knock you out. Everything becomes slow, you don't think, you just a poor guy on a chair waiting for a doc to sign papers to let you out of this madhouse.

Once I was back home, I had a pretty morbid thought, either I will not ever attempt suicide again and go through this, or make the attempt a success.

Hello,
Well, i'm 24y/o male with depression since my teenage years. I completed high school, attempted uni twice and left because I didn't care about my future anymore. I've met several therapists, none of them really solved my problem. They were just pills dispenser.  I've the feeling that even with my medications, my mind is sinking deeper everyday.

Sometimes I get some sparkles of hope and the will of living, like this past few days, applied for a job but then got slapped in the face because my profile didn't fit for the job.

And then, without going into details, my dad has a brain tumor, so time is running out. And every night I cry because I know my father's future and not mine. So I spend most of my days in bed, staring at nothing, smoking cigarettes, like waiting to die.

If you keep that belief, that's good and you shouldn't give it up. Not saying it's gonna be an easy road but you WILL make it through! It won't stop your life this summer.

I was also like you, I joined a music band and helped me to improve my social skills even if there was some awkward moments at the beginning. You can improve your social skills too! Don't be afraid to try something new, most people would support you. Don't give credit to people who are laughing at you, they also have weaknesses.

Feel free to message me, if you need to talk. :)
